sql: SELECT split_part(m.ticker,'-',1) AS series, count(*) AS markets, count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.close_time < now()) AS closed, count(DISTINCT split_part(m.ticker,'-',2)) FILTER (WHERE m.close_time < now()) AS closed_events, min(m.close_time)::date AS first_close, (SELECT count(*) FROM paper_trades p WHERE split_part(p.market_ticker,'-',1) = split_part(m.ticker,'-',1)) AS paper_trades_all_tags FROM markets m WHERE split_part(m.ticker,'-',1) IN ('KXGENERALCOUNTY','KXSTATEBALLOTMEASURE','KXAAAGASM','KXWAAEROEMP','KXCABALLOTMEASURES','KXWATECHEMP','KXNYNJPORTTEU','KXNYCASKRENT','KXFLVISITORCOUNT','KXILNUCLEAR','KXTXERCOTPEAK','KXWALLSTBONUS','KXCABUILDPERMITS','KXPAMFGEMP') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC
